en: The image shows the back of a postcard or photographic card, primarily text-based, featuring cataloging information. The postcard references Eva Plaschke-von der Osten (1881-1936) as Sieglinde in 'Die Walküre' from the Ring Cycle by Richard Wagner. It includes details of the photograph (with autograph), sizing (135 x 86 mm), and the location and year (Dresden, 1913). The card also bears cataloging and archival marks and is associated with the Sächsische Landesbibliothek, Deutsche Fotothek Dresden.
